statement.text: (a) Fix a long link L. What is the homotopy type of the embedding space of links isotopic to L? (b) Fix a link L in a 3-manifold M. What is the homotopy type of the embed- ding space of links in M isotopic to L? (c) Given a link $L$ obtained by infecting a link $L_{1}$ by another link $L_{2}$, describe the homotopy type of component of $L$ in the space of links in terms of the components of $L_{1}$ and $L_{2}$.

title: Kirby Problem 1.89
